item.title: Kentucky winter storm death toll rises to 12, governor says
item.description: FRANKFORT, Ky. — Gov. Andy Beshear said the death toll from this week’s winter storm in Kentucky has risen to 12 following the death of a 32-year-old woman in Fayette County.
